title: Snapp Carfix, Help it to fix itself
excerpt: My experience at Snapp Carfix: good friends, a failed Saleor project, and a company now heading toward bankruptcy.

blocks.text: The second company I went to for an interview in my life was Snapp Carfix. At that time their office was on Molla Sadra Street. The floor above Poytek, which was a social work space.
On the interview day I was very excited because Snapp is one of the most famous Iranian companies. Very famous. So much so that people go and enrich their career to work here.

I was stressed for the interview but when the interview started it had a very good vibe. I really don't remember what questions they asked but they were really very general and generic questions. They didn't ask much specialized because I had no work experience.
They liked me and in the end they told me you have to come for a one-week test, then we'll go for signing a contract. I also really liked there and its people and I said yessss of course!

From the next day when I went for a one-week test, I liked the people who were there very much. They were very cool in my opinion, both the girls and the boys were really good. They worked and in my opinion they were honest.
Even the call centers and the people who were in this section were also lovable.

Good memory. At that time one of the people in charge there said we will go in 3 months on the super app Snapp itself - 4 5 years passed but nothing 😂 I even know that they didn't sign a contract with Snapp this year either - actually Snapp didn't sign a contract with them. Anyway...

I became friends with everyone in the first week, Bahar who is still one of my good friends, Mehdi who is a very good friend, Hesam, Ali... really all young and looking for work and very honorable. Each one is now somewhere in the world and extremely successful.
I started my work with the Operation section. Believe me I understood nothing from that section. Because I was a programmer. What do I have to do with Operation?
But this same mistake of the company made me also connect with other sections, especially the finance and procurement sections, and my circle of connections really became wider.

Anyway I entered the Backend team and for a new project called Saleor they wanted us to work on it. The story was that this Saleor was the biggest e-commerce platform that was open source and they said we want to move all the features we currently have on the system there...
And they had put me in a team where my head was a girl named N.
Important note:

Never make someone the head of a team just because they have a lot of experience. Experience is not a good criterion for team management. Team management really needs soft skills. The team can really fall apart if you do this.
And that girl really didn't know management. Even now I think she doesn't know.
Because of the ethics that head had, before the project started I separated from this group, after 4 months of work.

And in my opinion at that same time this project had already failed. After 2 years when I followed up I found out that yes, this project really failed and later they took it to a section that works with outside the country and they are running it. Why did it fail? Because on the same 2nd day that I went I read the financial documents and handling of its financial parts and I understood that this does not match the Iranian financial system at all, and since there was a rule that the core should not be touched at all and the codes must stay fixed, I realized that it's no use and this project will fail.
My experience was extremely little but I understood...

Here it has a manager, its manager is really literally a person who has just reached money. I don't know what the right description is but he is not a proper and rooted person at all. He is also a very blunt and rude person in my opinion.

After my exit from the company, I found out how much a bunch of people that I also didn't deal with much were all together and had relationships with each other, even some of them had gotten married but there they would enter a relationship with someone else! Haha interesting, right?
I'm satisfied I stayed away from HIV and HPV 😂

In the end, this company in my opinion has average work value, right now their financial situation is not good at all, they don't give lunch anymore, they don't give overtime, and working hours have become 8 AM to 2 PM! They are heading toward bankruptcy. I also said above that this year Snapp didn't sign a contract with them :)
This company gave me extremely good friends who are still friends with me and I love them. It gave me a good experience to connect with people and learn.
It also had good learning challenges. I also always stayed at the company and worked much more than I should have.
By the way, let's remember Speideh who was one of the most professional and coolest people I have seen and we still keep in touch.
Is this company worth working at?
Average, both yes and no, it really depends on your wants, but if you are a beginner, definitely yes.
Snapp Carfix
